import itertools
import string
import pandas as pd
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt

def task_func():
    """
    Generate all possible 3-letter combinations from the lowercase alphabet,
    store them in a pandas DataFrame, and plot the frequency of the first
    letters as a histogram-like bar chart.

    Returns
    -------
    tuple
        (DataFrame, Axes)
        DataFrame with all 3-letter combinations.
        Matplotlib Axes object for the frequency plot.
    """
    alphabet = string.ascii_lowercase

    # Generate all 3-letter combinations
    combinations = list(itertools.product(alphabet, repeat=3))

    # Create DataFrame from combinations
    df = pd.DataFrame(combinations, columns=["first_letter", "second_letter", "third_letter"])

    # Frequency of first letters
    first_letter_counts = df["first_letter"].value_counts().sort_index()

    # Plot frequency chart
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))
    ax.bar(first_letter_counts.index, first_letter_counts.values, color="steelblue", edgecolor="black")
    ax.set_xlabel("First Letter")
    ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")
    ax.set_title("Frequency of First Letters in All 3-Letter Combinations")
    ax.set_xlim(-0.5, len(alphabet) - 0.5)

    return df, ax
